hero.subheading: I build reliable AI and data systems, from multilingual LLM workflows to production cloud pipelines.
hero.bio: I am completing an M.Sc. thesis on whether machine translation to English can improve Bengali reasoning across large language models, including a prompt- and model-aware inference router. Previously at Infosys, I built SAP-to-BigQuery pipelines for Google Cloud Cortex and data-lineage workflows for HSBC's restricted banking data.

about.heading: Sagnik Das — Data & AI Engineer based in Germany
about.paragraph1: My current focus is an M.Sc. thesis at Technische Universität Nürnberg (UTN) on machine-translation inference for low-resource Bengali NLP. I compare direct and translated inference across four LLMs and five datasets, analyze translation failures behind a preliminary 27.2-point Belebele gain, and use 35.6 points of oracle headroom to develop a prompt- and model-aware router. Before the master's, I worked at Infosys on Google Cloud Cortex and HSBC projects: building Python/Cloud Composer pipelines from SAP ECC and S/4HANA into BigQuery, optimizing views by 25%, and creating PySpark/Solidatus lineage workflows that improved data-lifecycle visibility by 30%.

experience.description: Built a Qwen 0.5B PEFT/RAG epistemology chatbot on Hugging Face Spaces, with optional Groq inference, and piloted it with about 50 students. Also built an LSE professor portfolio and automated seminar-site updates from Google Sheets.

Built Python DAGs in Cloud Composer for SAP ECC/S/4HANA-to-BigQuery CDC pipelines, plus optimized SQL views and materialized views that cut processing time by 25%. Developed Looker dashboards and Python/PySpark lineage workflows for restricted banking data, improving lifecycle visibility by 30%.

Built Scala/Spark de-identification services for PDF and HL7 ingestion, with HIPAA-compliant redaction and pseudonymization that preserved record linkage. Added OCR and table extraction, PostgreSQL metadata, authenticated access, and a Python/FastAPI version for additional clients.

Built a Python staffing system that matched 200K+ employee resumes to project job descriptions and surfaced released employees for open roles. Automated alerts to project and workforce managers, cutting staffing overhead by 40%, and built granular HTML/CSS views with Excel exports.

research.title: Low-Resource Bengali LLM Reasoning
research.description: Evaluating how severe training-data imbalance affects reasoning in Bengali and where model behavior changes across four LLMs and five benchmark datasets.

research.title: Machine Translation as Inference
research.description: Comparing direct Bengali inference with translation-to-English pipelines, including a preliminary 27.2-point gain on Belebele with Tiny Aya Fire.

research.title: Prompt- and Model-Aware Routing
research.description: Using up to 35.6 points of oracle headroom to develop a router that selects the most effective inference path for each prompt and model.

research.title: Translation Failure Analysis
research.description: Tracing when machine translation helps or harms downstream reasoning, with emphasis on semantic preservation and reproducible evaluation.

research.title: Applied AI for Education
research.description: Building specialist RAG and fine-tuned learning tools grounded in professor-curated content and validating them with real student cohorts.

projects.title: Bengali NLP via Machine-Translation Inference
projects.description: M.Sc. thesis comparing direct and machine-translation inference across four LLMs and five Bengali datasets. Current work analyzes a preliminary 27.2-point Belebele gain and trains a prompt- and model-aware inference router.

projects.title: Epistemology Course Chatbot
projects.description: A Qwen 0.5B PEFT/RAG assistant grounded in professor-curated epistemology course material, with optional Groq inference. Deployed on Hugging Face Spaces and piloted with about 50 students.

projects.title: Smart Bike Light System
projects.description: Weakly supervised residual CNN trained on 70K+ BDD100K samples for off/dim/high-beam control. Achieved 93.99% test accuracy and 20.4 ms inference (49 FPS) on Raspberry Pi 5, with ESP32-CAM video and GPIO relay control.

projects.title: Seminar Website Automation
projects.description: A maintainable seminar website where content is managed via Google Sheets — making event updates easy without editing code directly. Built for academic seminar use.
